title: Director at IT Provider Sees Samsara Gaining Share as Asset Tracking and Renewals Drive Growth
expert: Director at a very large managed service provider running Samsara for large enterprises (oil and gas, utilities, transport)
verdict: The expert's Samsara book grew 10%–15% y/y in Aug–Oct, with renewal spend 15%–25% higher and asset-tag ARR more than tripled.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟢 Renewal spend 15%–25% higher; expansion over one-half of book vs about one-third a year ago, vs 2026-11-05 call (96% renewals): confirming; vs Jefferies license-cost scrutiny (SB #62601): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↑
🟢 Asset-tag ARR more than tripled, one deployment of as many as 250,000 assets, vs mgmt emerging >20% of NNACV (SB #50487): confirming. → Tenet 2 (emerging products) ↑
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟢 Same-product prices 15%–20% higher y/y (estimate), vs 2026-11-05 call's +5%–7% on platform deals: higher. → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) ↑
🔴 Longer hardware lead times slowed a couple of multi-country rollouts, consistent with mgmt's component and supply costs through F2H27 (SB #62580); may defer revenue. → Tenet 3 ↓
Competition & share: 🟡 Motive wins SMB/mid-market on 12-month minimum terms, while Samsara gains in large enterprise; vs Jefferies aggressive-price competitors (SB #62604): consistent.

changes: Renewals: spend 15%–25% higher vs 2026-11-05 call's 96% renewal rate: confirming; vs Jefferies license-cost scrutiny at renewal (SB #62601): conflicting.
Emerging products: asset-tag ARR more than tripled vs mgmt emerging >20% of NNACV for 3 quarters (SB #50487): confirming.
Pricing: same-product +15%–20% y/y (estimate) vs 2026-11-05 call's +5%–7% platform: higher.
Supply: hardware lead times lengthened, slowing rollouts; vs mgmt component/supply costs persisting through F2H27 (SB #62580): confirming.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): ↑ — renewal spend +15%–25%, expansion over half of book (one-third a year ago).
Tenet 2 (emerging products): ↑ — asset-tag ARR more than tripled; 250,000-asset deployment.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): ↑ on price (+15%–20%), ↓ on lead-time-driven rollout delays.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↑ — share gains in large enterprise via consolidation.
